welcomeMessage: Welcome to Royal's Inn! 👋 I'm here to help. Ask me anything about our rooms, dining, events, or how to reach us.
fallbackResponse: I'm not sure about that one — but our team knows everything! 💬 Tap the WhatsApp button above to chat with us directly and get an instant answer.

rules.response: We offer AC Deluxe Rooms (₹1,800/night), AC Twin Rooms (₹2,200/night), AC Suites (₹3,200/night), and Non-AC rooms from ₹900/night. All rooms include free Wi-Fi, hot water, and LED TV. 🏨 Want to book? Tap WhatsApp above for instant confirmation!
Our Hostel wing has Dormitory Beds from ₹350/bed and Private Hostel Rooms from ₹650. All include free Wi-Fi, secure lockers, and access to our common social area. 🎒 Perfect for solo travellers!

Our restaurant 'The Table' serves Punjabi, Gujarati, South Indian, and Chinese cuisine. Highlights: Gujarati Thali (₹220), Masala Dosa (₹140), Butter Chicken (₹260), Dal Makhani (₹180). 🍛 All freshly prepared!

Royal's Inn hosts weddings, birthday parties, corporate events, and social gatherings. Our event spaces can be customized with decor and catering. 🎊 Contact us on WhatsApp to discuss your event requirements!
Our amenities include: Free High-Speed Wi-Fi 📶, 24/7 Hot Water, LED TVs, Room Service, Personal Lockers (hostel), Common Lounge, and on-site Dining. Need anything specific? Chat with us on WhatsApp!
We're located at: Eru Aat Road, opp. DGVCL office, Eru Char Rasta, Navsari, Gujarat 396450. 📍 Easy to find, close to the city centre. Get directions on Google Maps via our Contact page!
You can reach us at 📞 +91 95587 84840 or tap the WhatsApp button at the top of this chat for an instant reply from our team. We're available daily!
Room rates: AC Deluxe ₹1,800 · AC Twin ₹2,200 · AC Suite ₹3,200 · Non-AC Standard ₹900 · Hostel Bed ₹350. Prices may vary by season. 💰 WhatsApp us for current availability and special offers!
Check-in: 12:00 PM | Check-out: 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out may be available on request — just WhatsApp us! ⏰
